visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins in a brightly lit supermarket aisle, showing rows of colorful juice cartons on white metal shelves. A large pink and white text overlay is centered on the screen. (2) Two hands enter the frame, holding two small glass bottles—one containing orange juice and the other yellow juice—against the backdrop of a refrigerated display case. (3) A close-up shot focuses on a person's hands holding a blue Kagome juice box against a plain beige wall. A white plastic straw is being pushed through the top foil. (4) Another close-up shows hands holding a white juice box with an image of a red carrot. A straw is again inserted into the top. (5) The shot shifts back to the supermarket, where a hand holds a green Yakult juice box in front of shelves filled with similar green-packaged products. (6) A purple juice box is shown in a close-up; a straw is inserted, and then the hand is seen placing the box back onto a shelf stocked with identical items. (7) The camera captures the exterior entrance of an 'Ito Yokado' store with pedestrians walking in the background. It then pans quickly across long, packed supermarket aisles before concluding with a full-screen pink graphic displaying social media icons and brand logos.
